row.evidence: EasyPost prices by labels and usage (Free Access, BYOCA $20/month plus per-label fee, Enterprise custom), and dashboard users are added by email invitation with predefined roles ('it is currently free to add additional users'); no SSO or SCIM is documented.
row.notes: None by absence: support-centre search for 'scim' returns 0 articles and 'sso'/'saml' only hit a glossary and unrelated articles; the API reference (llms.txt index) has no SSO, SCIM or member endpoints. The API's User object covers the parent account and API-only child users (which cannot log in), not dashboard members. Usage-priced: Free Access (Wallet Carriers) up to 3,000 labels, BYOCA $20/month plus per-label fee, Enterprise custom; per-user fields null. Dashboard seats are free, max 100 additional users. Okta OIN and Entra gallery URL guesses returned 404.

user_api.notes: The Users API manages the parent account and API-only child users (billing sub-accounts that cannot log in); it cannot invite, list or disable dashboard members, which are managed only in Account Settings.

fallbacks.notes: Dashboard users are invited manually with predefined roles and can be disabled/re-enabled; login security is MFA, not SSO.
